newsitem.title: USA: Pacific Sunwear July same-store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Sunwear July same-store sales up.

text.p: Pacific Sunwear of California Inc Thursday reported an 18 percent rise in same store sales for the four weeks ended Aug. 3.
In a statement, the company said total sales rose 48 percent for the period to $15.7 million from $10.6 million last year.

Sales for the year's first half ended August 3, 1997 were $87.3 million, an increase of 40 percent over sales of $62.2 million for the first half of 1996. Same store sales increased 15 percent for the first half of 1997.
